headline: OL Lyonnes beat Arsenal 2-0 and hand them their first Champions League defeat of the season
facts: Lyon won 2-0 in the Women's Champions League league phase, with Jule Brand scoring early and Melchie Dumornay adding the second.
It was Arsenal's first European defeat of the season; they finished the night eighth in the league phase.
Lyon are on 13 points, unbeaten with five clean sheets, and are already through to the quarter-finals.
Arsenal now face Inter away in the final round and could still need a playoff.
background: Arsenal earlier made a historic run to a Champions League final against Barcelona, who are the reigning champions and were in this season's league phase, but have struggled for consistency in the WSL under manager Renee Slegers.
footage_terms: Arsenal vs Lyon Women's Champions League highlights

headline: Chelsea beat Man City 1-0 at Stamford Bridge to go top of the WSL, City keeper sent off
facts: Sandy Baltimore scored the only goal from the edge of the box.
City goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita was sent off for bringing down Alyssa Thompson outside her box.
It was City's first defeat of the season, and Chelsea went one point clear at the top.
Vivianne Miedema returned from injury for City and went close to an equaliser.
background: City won the league and cup double last season, while Chelsea manager Sonia Bompastor is rebuilding the squad after Emma Hayes left the club.
footage_terms: Chelsea vs Manchester City Women WSL highlights

headline: FA and WSL Football launch three-year study into ACL injuries in women's football
facts: The study is run with Imperial College London and covers every WSL and WSL2 club that wants to take part.
It compares players who had ACL injuries since 2018-19 with those who did not, then adds interviews with players and staff.
The player-focused study began in June and runs for three years.
Michelle Agyemang has been sidelined since October 2025.
background: Leah Williamson and Beth Mead both missed the 2023 World Cup because of ACL injuries, and the NWSL joined the separate Project ACL initiative in April.

headline: Drew Spence becomes the WSL's all-time appearance record holder in Tottenham's 4-1 win at Birmingham
facts: Spence made her 217th WSL appearance, passing former Chelsea defender Millie Bright.
Tottenham won 4-1, ending a three-match losing run in the league.
Julie Blakstad, Olivia Holdt, Signe Gaupset and Victoria Pelova scored for Spurs.
background: Spence is 34, captains Tottenham, and spent 14 years at Chelsea before joining Spurs in 2022.

headline: Mary Earps stars as London City hold Arsenal 1-1 at the Emirates
facts: Frida Maanum put Arsenal ahead in the 10th minute and Isobel Goodwin equalised a minute later.
Earps made a string of saves, including one fingertip tip onto the bar late on.
Arsenal remain winless at the Emirates this season.
London City are third on 20 points, six clear of sixth-placed Arsenal.
background: London City Lionesses and Lyon share an owner, Michele Kang, who also owns the NWSL's Washington Spirit.
footage_terms: Mary Earps saves Arsenal London City
Arsenal vs London City Lionesses highlights

headline: Washington Spirit host Kansas City Current in the NWSL Championship final
facts: The final is on Saturday at the Spirit's home, Audi Field.
Washington is in its third straight final after losing 1-0 in both 2024 and 2025.
Kansas City has never won the NWSL Championship.
Trinity Rodman has 12 goals and eight assists this season, her best yet.
Croix Bethune, a former Spirit player, broke the NWSL assists record.
background: Washington won its only NWSL title in 2021, and Kansas City lost the 2022 final at the same Audi Field.
footage_terms: Washington Spirit Kansas City Current NWSL final preview

headline: NWSL commissioner Berman 'frustrated' by playoff venue chaos
facts: Gotham moved its semifinal to the 5,000-seat Icahn Stadium after deeming its usual home field unsafe.
Washington's semifinal at Audi Field had yellow soccer lines painted over white football lines because of a double booking.
Berman said the league is working on solutions and that teams need more control over their stadiums.
Gotham plans to move to Etihad Park in 2028.
background: The NWSL has grown fast in money and ownership, but many clubs still rent stadiums controlled by MLS clubs or others.
footage_terms: NWSL playoff venue Icahn Stadium Gotham

headline: Ashley Sanchez wins NWSL MVP with a record-tying 20 goals for a team that missed the playoffs
facts: Sanchez scored 20 goals, tying the single-season record set by Temwa Chawinga in 2024.
She also had 5 assists and led the league with 25 goal contributions.
Her 20 goals were more than her first five NWSL seasons combined.
She is only the second player to win MVP while her team missed the playoffs.
background: Sanchez joined the North Carolina Courage from the Washington Spirit in a January 2024 trade.

headline: England defender Jess Carter leaves Gotham for Bay FC
facts: Carter, 29, signed as a free agent on a deal through 2028 with an option for 2029.
She played all 30 regular-season games for Gotham in 2026.
Bay FC's football chief Paul Green worked with her at Chelsea.
She is in England's squad for the December World Cup playoff against Ukraine.
background: Carter won five straight WSL titles at Chelsea, joined Gotham in 2024, won the 2025 NWSL Championship, and has 56 England caps.

headline: Houston Dash hire ex-champion coach Seb Hines after his Orlando Pride exit
facts: Hines is the Dash's seventh full-time head coach in the club's 12-year history.
Orlando fired him this season while the team was 12th.
The Dash's women's soccer president said he brings a track record of success.
Contract terms were not given.
background: Hines won the 2024 NWSL Shield and Championship with Orlando, was 2024 Coach of the Year, and in 2022 became the first Black head coach in NWSL history.

headline: FC Cincinnati close to buying NWSL's Racing Louisville and moving the team in 2028
facts: Multiple sources say the two ownership groups are nearing a deal; nothing is finalised and no price is reported.
Racing would play 2027 in Louisville, then move about 100 miles to FC Cincinnati's 26,000-seat TQL Stadium.
Racing says it is working through a process to sell the club.
Racing averaged just under 5,500 fans per game this year.
background: Racing joined the NWSL in 2021 for about $2 million, while recent expansion fees are far higher: Columbus paid $205 million and Atlanta $165 million. Commissioner Berman has called relocation a last resort.

headline: Veerle Buurman's 87th-minute header-in sends Chelsea past PSG in the Champions League
facts: Buurman bundled in a corner at the near post in the 87th minute for a 1-0 win.
Chelsea are on 11 points from five matches and control their own route to a direct quarter-final spot.
Chelsea created little in the match, and PSG are on 5 points.
Chelsea have not conceded in five league-phase games but have scored only four.
background: Sonia Bompastor has built Chelsea around defensive strength, and the team has the best defensive record in the WSL.
footage_terms: Chelsea vs PSG Women's Champions League highlights

headline: Man City beat Häcken 2-0 with two substitute goals, but Fowler's late penalty is saved
facts: Lauren Hemp scored in the 55th minute from a deflection, and Khadija Shaw added a second in the 77th.
Both scorers came on at half-time.
Jennifer Falk saved Mary Fowler's late penalty.
It was City's second straight away European win after three draws.
background: Man City won the WSL and the cup last season and are led by Swedish coach Andree Jeglertz.
footage_terms: Häcken vs Manchester City Women highlights

headline: Arsenal end Barcelona's 11-game home winning run in the Champions League with a 1-1 draw
facts: Frida Maanum gave Arsenal an early lead and Caroline Graham Hansen equalised.
Barcelona had 24 shots to Arsenal's 7 but wasted their chances.
The draw ended Barcelona's 11-game home winning streak in the competition.
Renee Slegers called the result a big boost to her team's process.
background: Barcelona are the reigning Champions League holders, and Arsenal were considered underdogs at Camp Nou.
footage_terms: Barcelona vs Arsenal Women Champions League highlights

headline: Real Madrid beat Inter 3-1 as Signe Bruun scores twice in the last minutes
facts: Real Madrid had 25 shots but the game was 1-1 until the 85th minute.
Substitute Signe Bruun scored the winner, then a late penalty won by Linda Caicedo.
Inter goalkeeper Cecilia Ran Runarsdottir made nine saves and leads the competition with 41.
Madrid are unbeaten and fourth with nine points; they finish the league phase at Roma.
background: Madrid were knocked out at the quarter-final stage in each of the last two seasons, by Arsenal and Barcelona.
footage_terms: Real Madrid Femenino vs Inter highlights

headline: Women's Champions League: Barcelona and Lyon through, Chelsea and Bayern close, final matchday set for Dec 16
facts: Barcelona and Lyon have qualified directly for the quarter-finals; Austria Wien are eliminated.
Bayern Munich (3rd) and Chelsea (4th) are best placed to join them in the top four.
The final matchday is Dec 16, with the knockout draw on Dec 17.
The final is on May 29 at the Stadion Narodowy in Warsaw.
Key last-round games include Bayern v Barcelona and Inter v Arsenal.
background: The competition uses a league phase with direct quarter-final places for the top four and playoffs for positions five to twelve.
footage_terms: Women's Champions League 2026-27 league phase highlights
Bayern vs Barcelona Women Champions League preview

headline: Clubs and U.S. Soccer clash over control of USWNT players in the NWSL
facts: The tension came to a head over the U20 World Cup, which fell outside a FIFA window so clubs did not have to release players.
Several age-eligible players, including Claire Hutton, Lily Yohannes and Kimmi Ascanio, were left off the U20 squad.
The NWSL will start its 2027 season on February 11, a month earlier than before, to allow a six-week World Cup break.
Anonymous GMs complained that the federation expects clubs to accommodate it at any cost; one GM praised Emma Hayes as supportive.
USWNT coach Emma Hayes said the team needs its best players available for long-term development.
background: U.S. Soccer helped found the NWSL in 2013 and paid USWNT players' salaries until the league became independent after the 2020 season.
footage_terms: NWSL U.S. Soccer player release dispute

headline: England name squad for Ukraine World Cup playoff, with two uncapped call-ups
facts: England play Ukraine in Spain on Dec 1 and at Wembley on Dec 5; the winner goes to the 2027 World Cup in Brazil.
Isobel Goodwin and goalkeeper Katie Cox get their first senior call-ups.
Lucy Bronze returns and is two caps from 150.
Alex Greenwood and Lauren James are among those out injured.
England beat Greece 8-1 on aggregate to reach the playoff, and Sarina Wiegman has extended her contract through Euro 2029.
background: England reached the 2023 World Cup final. Ukraine cannot play home matches because of the war, so the first leg is held in Spain.

headline: Teenager pleads not guilty over racist message to England defender Jess Carter during Euro 2025
facts: A 19-year-old appeared at Chelmsford Magistrates' Court and pleaded not guilty.
The charge is sending an offensive or menacing message over a public network on July 17, 2025, the day of England's quarter-final against Sweden.
Trial is set for October 2027 at Cambridge Magistrates' Court.
The defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.
background: Jess Carter was part of England's Euro 2025 squad and has since moved from Gotham to Bay FC in the NWSL.

headline: Defending champions Gotham go out of NWSL playoffs without a shot on goal
facts: Kansas City won the semifinal 2-1 at Icahn Stadium; Haley Hopkins scored the winner in the 89th minute.
Gotham's only goal was an own goal, and they had no shot on target despite 65% possession.
Midge Purce said the performance was not good enough.
Gotham had a heavy injury toll, and star scorer Esther Gonzalez left for Saudi Arabia in August.
background: Gotham won the 2025 NWSL Championship and were forced to play this semifinal at a 5,000-seat stadium usually used for amateur events.
footage_terms: Gotham FC vs Kansas City Current semifinal highlights
Haley Hopkins winner Kansas City Current

headline: Washington Spirit beat Utah Royals 2-1 in the semifinal after the earliest playoff goal in NWSL history
facts: Cloe Lacasse scored from a corner at 1:57, the earliest playoff goal in NWSL history.
Sofia Cantore equalised with an assist from Trinity Rodman, and Clara Luvanga scored the winner in the 56th minute.
The Spirit are unbeaten in eight postseason home games, including two penalty shootouts.
Rodman re-signed on a three-year extension this offseason.
background: Michele Kang became controlling owner in 2023 and also owns London City Lionesses and OL Lyonnes; the Spirit won their last title in 2021.
footage_terms: Washington Spirit vs Utah Royals semifinal highlights

headline: Arsenal draw 1-1 with Aston Villa as pressure grows on Renee Slegers
facts: Chasity Grant scored for Villa in the 25th minute from their only shot, deflecting off Steph Catley.
Alessia Russo equalised with an 85th-minute header from a Stina Blackstenius cross.
Georgia Stanway missed a stoppage-time chance to win it.
Arsenal have won only one of their last five league games and sat seventh, 12 points behind Chelsea.
background: Renee Slegers is Arsenal's manager, and her side earlier made a run to a Champions League final against Barcelona.
footage_terms: Arsenal vs Aston Villa Women highlights

headline: Tottenham boss says WSL refereeing has got worse after contentious Arsenal penalty in derby
facts: Arsenal won the north London derby 2-1, with Alessia Russo scoring a penalty for handball against Ella Morris.
Tottenham manager Martin Ho said the ball came off a teammate from close range, so it should not have been a penalty.
He said refereeing in the WSL is worse than last season and called for more full-time referees.
The WSL uses no VAR.
background: The WSL does not use VAR, and not all of its officials are full-time.
footage_terms: Arsenal vs Tottenham Women derby highlights

headline: Ballon d'Or night in London: Alexia Putellas collects the women's award, Harry Kane the men's
facts: The ceremony was held at the London Palladium on a Monday evening.
Alexia Putellas received the women's Ballon d'Or and Harry Kane the men's.
Arsenal forward Alessia Russo said Kane is a childhood role model and the night motivated her.
background: Putellas has won the women's Ballon d'Or before.
footage_terms: Alessia Russo Ballon d'Or Kane reaction

headline: FIFA clears US-led and UK bids for Women's World Cups, vote set for Nov 23
facts: FIFA said both joint bids met minimum requirements.
Members vote at an Extraordinary FIFA Congress on Nov 23.
The 2031 bid (US, Mexico, Costa Rica, Jamaica) is the only one for 2031 and proposes 20 stadiums for a 48-team event.
The 2035 UK bid proposes 19 stadiums with the final at Wembley.
background: The 2031 Women's World Cup will expand from 32 to 48 teams.
footage_terms: Women's World Cup 2031 bid USA Mexico
Women's World Cup 2035 UK bid Wembley
FIFA Congress Women's World Cup hosts

headline: FIFA plans to at least double 2027 Women's World Cup prize money, still short of equal pay
facts: FIFA's administration will propose at least doubling prize money for the 2027 tournament in Brazil.
The plan goes to the FIFA Council in December for approval.
Even doubled, it would stay below the men's tournament total.
The 2023 tournament had a record $150 million package, including $110 million in prize money.
Each association will get $2.5 million in preparation funds.
background: Infantino said in 2023 that the aim was equal prize money for the 2026 men's and 2027 women's tournaments.
footage_terms: Women's World Cup prize money equal pay
Infantino Women's World Cup prize money

headline: 2027 Women's World Cup draw set for Dec 11, with top four ranked teams kept apart until the semifinals
facts: The draw is on Dec 11 in Rio de Janeiro, with seeding from FIFA rankings as of Dec 7.
The four highest-ranked teams are kept apart if they win their groups, so they cannot meet before the semifinals.
The current top four are Spain, the United States, Germany and England.
Pot 1 is Brazil plus the top seven ranked teams.
background: The change follows the approach used at the men's World Cup earlier this year, and the 2027 tournament is hosted by Brazil.
footage_terms: FIFA Women's World Cup draw seeding

headline: Nigeria beat Japan 2-1 to become the first African team to win a FIFA Women's world title (U17)
facts: Nigeria won the U17 Women's World Cup final in Rabat 2-1 against Japan.
Oluebube Umejiaku scored four goals in the tournament and won the Golden Ball.
Nigeria lost its opening game to Poland and then beat defending champion North Korea.
Nigeria is only the second country, after France, to win both the men's and women's U17 World Cups.
Their coach, Busari, is local.
background: Nigeria's senior Super Falcons have won a record 10 African titles but failed to reach the 2027 Women's World Cup after losing a playoff to South Africa.
footage_terms: Nigeria vs Japan U17 Women's World Cup final highlights
Nigeria Flamingos celebrate U17 World Cup

headline: Randy Waldrum named Malawi women's head coach on a two-year deal
facts: Waldrum, a veteran American coach, signed a two-year contract with Malawi.
He replaces Lovemore Fazili, who becomes his assistant.
Malawi reached the 2026 WAFCON final in its first attempt, losing 3-0 to Cameroon.
Malawi also qualified for the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil.
background: Waldrum previously coached Nigeria to the 2023 Women's World Cup round of 16 and was also head coach of the Houston Dash.
footage_terms: Randy Waldrum Nigeria Super Falcons World Cup 2023

headline: Alen Stajcic takes charge of Indonesia women's team on a three-year contract
facts: Stajcic, 53, replaces Japanese coach Satoru Mochizuki.
His first goal is qualifying for the 2029 Women's Asian Cup; the long-term aim is Indonesia's first Women's World Cup.
Friendlies against Bhutan (Nov 29) and Lebanon (Dec 5) are planned in Kudus.
background: Stajcic took Australia to the 2015 World Cup quarter-finals and led the Philippines to their first Women's World Cup in 2023, where they beat co-hosts New Zealand 1-0.
footage_terms: Alen Stajcic Philippines Women's World Cup New Zealand

headline: NWSL GM survey: the Rodman Rule, rule-breaking claims and doubts over a USWNT World Cup win
facts: The High Impact Player rule lets teams spend up to $1 million above the cap; it was passed to keep Trinity Rodman from leaving for Europe.
Rodman re-signed with the Spirit for over $2 million a year.
Several GMs said rule-breaking still happens but is less widespread than in 2024, when nearly 80% said teams were cheating.
GMs praised Emma Hayes's overhaul of the USWNT, and three GMs said no to a US win in 2027, all picking Brazil.
The 2026 salary cap is $3.7 million.
background: Angel City FC was fined $200,000 and lost three league points after a 2024 sanction for salary cap circumvention.

headline: Nigeria's Super Falcons set 2028 Olympic gold as goal after WAFCON and World Cup failures
facts: Interim coach Augustine Eguavoen said the team set its eyes on an Olympic gold medal in 2028.
Nigeria lost the 2026 WAFCON quarter-final to Cameroon and lost a World Cup playoff to South Africa.
They beat Comoros 7-0 on aggregate in Olympic qualifying and face Morocco next.
Eguavoen called the gold goal easier said than done.
background: Nigeria have won a record 10 African titles but never an Olympic medal; their best was the quarter-finals at Athens 2004.
footage_terms: Super Falcons Olympic qualifier Comoros highlights
